g.text: → postId of that day's daily (idempotency lock)
→ zset · one packed int ranks the whole board
→ hash · hSetNX = your one scored attempt
→ {last, cur, best} · streaks pay out as flair
→ the boss army, stored as JSON on the post

svg.text: no game servers · no matchmaking · the sim replays from the seed, redis keeps score
